texts.label: text
texts.orig: This is a sample checking account bank statement showing checks that have cleared the bank. Use this to practice the steps you will take to balance your checking account each month.
texts.text: This is a sample checking account bank statement showing checks that have cleared the bank. Use this to practice the steps you will take to balance your checking account each month.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Open your bank statement and look for charges (other than checks) made against your account.
texts.text: Open your bank statement and look for charges (other than checks) made against your account.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. Subtract those charges from your checkbook register.
texts.text: Subtract those charges from your checkbook register.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Remove your canceled checks from your statement and put them in order by check number.
texts.text: Remove your canceled checks from your statement and put them in order by check number.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. Compare the amounts on the canceled checks and deposits with the amounts written in your checkbook register. Check off all canceled checks and deposits in the checkbook register.
texts.text: Compare the amounts on the canceled checks and deposits with the amounts written in your checkbook register. Check off all canceled checks and deposits in the checkbook register.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. Insert the last balance shown on your bank statement
texts.text: Insert the last balance shown on your bank statement

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6. Add deposits not credited to your account.
texts.text: Add deposits not credited to your account.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. Deduct all checks that are outstanding (not checked off in your checkbook register, and therefore not yet charged to your account).
texts.text: Deduct all checks that are outstanding (not checked off in your checkbook register, and therefore not yet charged to your account).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. Your adjusted balance should agree with the balance in your checkbook register. If it doesn't, check your addition and subtraction, then check to be sure you have entered all the numbers correctly.
texts.text: Your adjusted balance should agree with the balance in your checkbook register. If it doesn't, check your addition and subtraction, then check to be sure you have entered all the numbers correctly.
